results.name: Existing Pokedex knowledge and command-granted shiny Pokemon do not create capture events or historical counts
Naturally spawned shiny Pokemon captured by native ball collision/animation produces verified evidence and category snapshot
Replaying the already observed native event cannot double-count ball/Pokemon identity
Real ball capture of an administratively created wild entity is audited as unknown and never becomes legitimate statistics
Distinct same-species captures accumulate; rule reload affects future captures without rewriting historical classifications
Own read-only statistics distinguish capture totals from species count, honor timezone and expose unknown origins separately
Another genuine native spawn is preserved for the restart provenance test without manufacturing its spawn cause

captures-restart.target: Packaged Fabric0.17.2 / MC1.21.1 / Cobblemon1.8.3 native spawn/ball/capture flow

results.name: Permanent totals, shiny snapshots, historical category and duplicate protection survive restart
Reloaded entity without retained spawn cause is explicitly unverified, never guessed legitimate
Only authorized operators open a frozen-payload preview; recipient and reason are disclosed without item delivery
Stale confirmation rechecks operator permission and recipient collection permission before every effect
Recipient disconnect invalidates an old recovery confirmation without altering its reservation
Pending recovery preserves the original plan/components/operation ID, delivers only to recipient once, and records operator/reason
Empty review can resume; any intent, acknowledged prefix or changed frozen payload refuses replay
Reload cannot substitute new reward data into an old confirmed recovery plan
Recovery preview cannot leak reward icons or create replacement operations
Native target inventory and original completed operation IDs survive restart without redelivery
Closed, uncertain, partial and changed operations remain blocked across restart; untouched reservation stays pending

verified_contract: Pre-hit wild state and exact PlayerSpawner/current world pool, then matching ball/Pokemon/player at native completion; main thread only
First positive captures came from real naturally spawned Pokemon and native projectile collision/animation; no fabricated first capture event or spawn cause
Repeat emission of an already observed native payload does not increment or rewrite event snapshot
Command-granted shiny does not create observations; administratively created entity captured by real engine remains UNKNOWN
Two distinct same-species captures count twice and yield one distinct species; shiny counts use observed Pokemon field
Classification changes affect only subsequent captures; current query can read a historical removed category
Loaded-after-restart natural entity lost SpawnCause and was captured as UNKNOWN, excluded even though shiny
Migration5 to6 preserves a previous reward plan and invents no old captures; schema6 recovery still enforces its safety guards
Permanent totals/species/category aggregates are transactionally independent of detailed event retention; no pruning feature exposed
corrected_attempts: Initial test projectile did not complete native capture; controlled test arena/collision geometry was corrected in probe, without fabricating capture evidence
Species stats CLI initially used Brigadier word and rejected namespace colon; changed to greedyString plus identifier validation and repeated native suite
DatabaseTest expected five migration rows; expectation updated for six, with explicit legacy upgrade test
Capture location uses ball dimension/position, not later player position; final runtime binary includes this correction
limitations: Only scope with correlated pre-hit evidence and current-world-pool PlayerSpawner proven; battle/fishing/custom-spawner paths not certified
SpawnCause provenance is not retained across entity reload; cannot safely classify those captures without additional observed persistent proof
Pre-hit buffer bounded at512 and ten minutes; absent/expired/mismatched evidence fails closed
No retroactive capture reconstruction, complete admin/history review, rate limits, personal records, rankings or competitions
Shiny capture total does not yet feed previous Shiny completion collection/percentage
No detailed-record pruning; calendar counts need preserved aggregates before implementing retention
DB/snapshot failures can leave gaps and are logged; no distributed transaction, power-loss or load/graphical-client guarantee
Full legacy Pokemon/currency/Crates protocol suites not repeated; all Java suites and native recovery regression repeated
